AssetStudio reference used by Thru3D's Unity scene importer

Upstream: https://github.com/Perfare/AssetStudio
Reference: https://github.com/Perfare/AssetStudio/blob/d158e864b556b5970709c2a52e47944d53aa98a2/AssetStudio/CommonString.cs

The matching part of Thru3D's embedded Unity type-tree common-string table
(native/unity-scene/common_strings.inc) uses AssetStudio's public table as a
reference. The original notice is in AssetStudio-LICENSE.txt.

Thru3D's own scene unpacker follows the LZ4 block format and the public-domain
LZMA reference decoder described in the LZMA SDK by Igor Pavlov.
https://github.com/lz4/lz4/blob/dev/doc/lz4_Block_format.md
https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html
